Package it.polimi.ingsw.am54.network.server

package it.polimi.ingsw.am54.network.server
Server side of the network. Server starts the two transports (TCP Socket on 12345 and RMI on 1099); the per-client handlers (SocketClientHandler, RMIClientHandler) implement the abstraction ClientConnection.

VirtualView observes the model and translates each event into a network message to its own client; PersistenceManager saves/restores the game on JSON files for crash recovery.

    SocketClientHandler
    ============================================================================ SocketClientHandler — Handler for a TCP connection for a client ============================================================================ ROLE: - Separate thread for each client connected via TCP Socket - Reads Requests from the client and forwards them to the Controller (single game) - Implements ClientConnection (sendUpdate) and ClientHandler - Manages the heartbeat system (ping/pong) to detect disconnections PING-PONG PATTERN: - Ping every 5 seconds (PING_INTERVAL_MS) - If no Pong is received within 15 seconds (PING_TIMEOUT_MS): 1.
    VirtualView
    ============================================================================ VirtualView — Proxy Pattern between Model and network ============================================================================ --- ROLE: The Game (Model) knows nothing about the network.
